evals.expected_output: A report flagging PUT /users/:id as high severity for two compounding issues (no ownership check, and an unrestricted role field that lets a caller grant themselves or anyone else a new role), with a fix that adds an ownership check and strips/restricts the role field, while PUT /users/:id/name is left unflagged because it already checks req.user.id !== req.params.id.

Does not flag the PUT /users/:id/name handler, since it already checks req.user.id !== req.params.id before performing the update — restraint / false-positive check
Assigns high severity to the PUT /users/:id finding
